plan.goal: Dose a compound at 1 mM working concentration from a 200 mM DMSO stock and flag the DMSO solvent burden at the 0.5% v/v toxicity guideline.
plan.rationale: Working concentration of 1 mM from a 200 mM DMSO stock gives a DMSO volume fraction of 0.005 (0.5% v/v), which sits exactly at the solvent-toxicity guideline threshold. This is the upper edge of acceptable for most cell types; a matched vehicle control at the same DMSO level is required to separate solvent effects from compound effects. The user should verify cell viability at this DMSO level in a pilot run before committing.
caveats: DMSO sits exactly at 0.5% v/v, the solvent-toxicity guideline threshold — verify cell viability at this level in a pilot run before committing
Include a matched vehicle-only control at 0.5% v/v DMSO to separate solvent effects from compound effects
Consider lowering working concentration or using a more concentrated stock to reduce DMSO burden if potency allows
